reviews.text: We did private lessons with Natalie, and it was wonderful! Our dog is 7 months old, leash reactive, and had a hard time adjusting to city life. Natalie gave us useful and approachable tools to help with this. She always came prepared with exercises and was very knowledgeable on pet behavior, answering all of our questions! We are thankful we did the private lessons—they helped get our pup off on the right foot and gave us the tools and knowledge to continue training her moving forward.

Maureen was excellent. Our pittie/staffie pup went from needing multiple fences and sheets between him and strangers (sessions 1-4) to having Maureen doing home visits and, during our last session, allowing me and my partner to leave him and Maureen alone in the house together!
The progress has been outstanding, and we’ll continue to use Tucker Pups—Maureen specifically—for future training needs.

We’ve had a really great experience working with Phaedra through Tucker Pup’s Drop-Off Training program. We originally signed Cliff up for one round and have already started a second because of how much progress we’ve seen.

Cliff came into the program as a typical high-energy puppy with a short attention span, especially in distracting environments. Since working with Phaedra, we’ve seen noticeable improvements in his focus, leash behavior, and overall ability to settle and make better decisions both at home and outside.

What we’ve appreciated most is how thoughtful and practical her approach is. She does a great job balancing structured training with real-world application, and the weekly progress sessions have been extremely helpful for us as owners to understand how to reinforce everything at home.

She’s also been very honest and communicative about Cliff’s progress, which we’ve really valued. It’s clear she cares about the dogs she’s working with and wants to set them up for long-term success, not just short-term results.

Overall, we’ve been very happy with the program and working with Phaedra, it’s been a great investment for Cliff and for us.

We enrolled our 5 month old husky/chow/German shepherd puppy in the drop-off training program and we could not be happier! Our trainer, Olivia, is fantastic! Our puppy loves his sessions with Olivia and loves the playgroups he gets to be in when he's not in 1-on-1 training. We can't recommend Tucker Pups enough!

Great experience across the board with grooming, training, and boarding!
Update: Phaedra has been amazing with drop off training. Our dog Koda absolutely loves her and she does an excellent job of listening to our needs as pawrents and pivoting as needed, too. She really goes above and beyond, is kind and soft, but still stern enough to train Koda effectively (and get us humans on the right page too when we need to adjust our own training behavior). Fantastic experience.

Helena was absolutely fantastic. We would work with her over and over again. We wish there was space in daycare for Auggie to keep coming to Tuckers. It would be amazing if you offered daycare with occasional training days built in to reup on skills with your favorite trainer. We would come back to Helena over and over again!
Tiffany, Patrick and Auggie

Hands down the best training in the city. We worked with Helena Love at Tucker Pups (drop-off training) and our 6 month old golden retriever has made remarkable progress we couldn't have done on our own. Helena is truly a dog whisperer and was extremely informative with us every step of the way. Could not recommend Helena and the Tucker Pups Resort any more!!!

Jamie was an absolute godsend for our pup Polly. Polly was an incredibly nervous dog and over the months working with Jamie she truly came out of her shell and is able to show her funny personality. Jamie was the best to work with since she really was able to break down training and relaxation protocols for Polly and for us to make sure that we never overwhelmed her. I would recommend working with Jamie any day! Polly is truly a different dog and I don't think that would have happened without Jamie's support.

I was traveling out of the country and felt very confident in the care that my dog was getting while I was away. They were consistent with photo updates, very accommodating when our travel plans abruptly changed, and he came back very happy! The staff is all very friendly and you can tell they genuinely love our animals. We’re very satisfied with his stay and will be back!

We love Tucker Pups! We started out with the training and daycare program; now we go for our grooming and boarding needs too. The staff is so friendly and helpful. Their love & care  is palpable and we always know our girl is in goods hands when she is there. Thank you Tucker Pups <3

I have no words that would do justice to Jessie and her training of my puppy. ChatGPT couldn’t even do justice as she is absolutely wonderful, professional, and fabulous at her job. My pup Okoye adores her and is now a better pup because of her.  I looked out when Kim picked her for my Pups training.

Thank you for having Jessie on your staff.

Jamie was a great trainer and my girl really loved her. She was helpful and throughout the class made sure each dog had individual attention. She addressed any concerns and offered tips readily and was extremely knowledgeable. I would love to have her as a trainer in any future classes at Tucker Pups. Throughout the class we learned the basics sit, stay, down, recall, walking on a leash, leave it, touch, paying attention to owner instead of distractions, and a few other things. I enjoyed how the dogs got to play and interact but also had personalized attention.

Burt loved his time at Tucker Pups! We just completed Adult Manners with Maureen. She is attentive and a dog whisperer. She helps trouble shoot what may be going on with certain tricks and uses the positive reinforcement method. Burt has learned so much since being in training and we can’t wait for his next round!

We have had the privilege of working with two great trainers at Tucker Pups. Courtney helped us when we first brought our rescue home and got her acclimated to the new home and obedience practices. Over time we used Jamie for more advanced behavioral training. I want to recognize both for their patience, care for our dog, and knowledge. We appreciate that Tucker pups has multiple trainers with spikes in different areas, but high quality and consistent techniques.

Jamie did an amazing job with our weekly group Adult Manners class! We brought our 9 month old Golden Retriever puppy alongside other adult dogs and she was great at managing the room and helping us with our commands. We originally came in for help with leash training and learned some great ways to help manage leash pulling outside of class on our daily downtown Chicago walks. I would definitely recommend Jamie for dog training and will be coming back to Tucker Pup's!

MANNER CLASS: we attended Adult Manner class, and although we were initially unsure about its effectiveness, it turned out to be absolutely perfect. We learned so much, especially about how to reinforce correctly. Natalie was amazing, and we loved her so much that we’ve already booked private lessons with her.
Through this experience, we also got to know Tucker Pup’s vision, culture, and environment which are exactly what we’ve been looking for for our fur baby, who is now happily enrolled in both daycare and boarding.
BOARDING: I couldn’t be happier with Ivy’s boarding experience! The team was incredibly attentive to her and all of her needs, and they made sure to keep me updated every step of the way. Their constant care and communication gave me so much peace of mind. And the photos: they were truly the cherry on top! Highly recommend!
DAYCARE: Ivy is at her happiest the moment she reaches the entrance. Her tail starts wagging, her whole body shakes, and you can just tell how much she loves being there (P.S.: after daycare, she just sleeps like a baby). Tucker’s Pup truly treats her like family: constant updates, incredible care, and so much love. We absolutely adore them.

Jas did such a great job grooming our 1 year old pup Cosmo ! You can tell from the results how she was very thorough with the cut and was excellent at the finer details around the eyes, ears and face in general. Those details are difficult for us to express in words but for example: Cosmo can see well now with no hair in his way but he still has eyebrows and even eyelashes. He looks perfect, smells so good and is even softer to touch. Thank you so much Jas and Tucker Pup !!

We love the puppy socials here - our friends recommended them and I couldn't be more grateful. Momo started going when he was 13 weeks and there was really no other place for him to run around and meet other dogs. He really loves them. And it's been so helpful for us to see how he interacts with other dogs, what to look out for, what certain behaviors signal - they're just as much a learning experience for us as they are fun. The trainers are amazing. Helena is such a calm, kind and confident presence in the room.

Phaedra is a great drop off trainer for our pup. He is an anxious guy, and she was very patient with him (and us) on making great steps to improve is confidence and our ability to understand and work with him at home. The tools were shown clearly and the online resources gave us the backup we needed to revisit those teaching skills. Our pup also enjoyed his day care time playing with all the other dogs. He was super excited when we would get ready to go to Tucker Pups for the day!

Our dog, Westley (@mrwestleys), is obsessed with Tucker’s. We’ve tried other daycare/boarding places in the city since we moved from the West Loop, but we always find ourselves returning to Tucker’s because we love them that much! We adore the photos we get of our Westley having the best time (see pics attached!) with all his other buddies under the care of the Tucker Pup’s team. We know he’ll always be well taken care of and as dog parents that’s all we can hope for when we’re out of town! We highly recommend Tucker’s for your daycare/boarding needs!!
